answer: Ten Degree Proof links every new account to a unique, time-stamped thermal signature captured from a physical device. The system tracks the thermal shadow cast by solid objects, which creates an immutable **ledge** of state that cannot be duplicated by software alone. To forge a new identity, an attacker must physically cool a specific area below ambient temperature, generating an **ember** of energy data that is logged in a distributed ledger. Each attempt to bypass this thermal gate drains battery life and computational power, placing a heavy **knoll** of overhead on any mass imitation.
